title: Study Visa Consultant Bangladesh | Dhaka Digital Desk — SK Immigration
description: SK Immigration prepares study and visit files for applicants in Bangladesh — Germany, UK, Canada and Europe. Digital-first from Dhaka, appointment if you want a meeting. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: Yes. SK Immigration is digital-first and also meets in Dhaka by appointment. WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 for the current meeting point and a written scope.

faqs.question: Can Bangladeshi students apply for Germany or Canada through you?
faqs.answer: We prepare files against current rules for Bangladeshi passports — including APS/funds themes for many German degree paths and SDS/funds themes for Canada where they apply. Missions decide the visa.

faqs.question: Do you work only in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: The desk is digital, so Chattogram, Sylhet and other cities can work fully online. Dhaka is the appointment city if you want to meet.

faqs.question: Will you guarantee a student visa from Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and universities decide. Anyone selling a guaranteed visa from Dhaka is not someone you should pay.

faqs.question: Is SK Immigration a Bangladeshi company?
faqs.answer: The legal entity is SK Immigration Services (SMC-Private) Limited (Pakistan, CUIN 0304985). The service for Bangladeshi clients is the same digital file-prep desk, with a Dhaka appointment option.

body:
SK Immigration is a digital study-visa desk for applicants in Bangladesh, with a Dhaka appointment option. You work in English (and Urdu if that helps). You get a written fee. You do not get a fake guarantee.

Who this page is for

Students and parents in Dhaka and across Bangladesh searching for a study visa consultant in Bangladesh who will map Germany, UK, Canada or other destinations to real academics and funds — not to a billboard.

What we prepare for Bangladeshi applicants

  • Germany study and Ausbildung guidance (APS, blocked account / contract reality, language)
  • UK and Ireland study files when CAS/funds rules can actually be met
  • Canada and other study paths when the profile fits
  • Visit files and attestation only when the destination requires them

Digital first in Bangladesh

Share scans on WhatsApp. We reply with destination fit and a written scope. Dhaka meetings are for families who want to sit with the file. They are not a requirement and they are not a shortcut at the embassy.

Honest limits

  • We do not control VFS Dhaka slot calendars
  • We do not issue university offers
  • Low CGPA and long gaps need truthful destination choice

How to start from Bangladesh

  1. Send academics, passport biodata and a budget range
  2. Written scope before payment
  3. Document and SOP/CV work as agreed
  4. Optional Dhaka appointment
  5. Official submission. Authorities decide.
